parsed.note_claim: On 9/7/26, King Charles III through his Lord Chamberlain released an official statement that Meghan Markle is not a working royal, is a private citizen, and any charitable work is personal and private.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The charitable work of the Duke and Duchess is a personal matter for them both and undertaken in their private capacity. In short, their position is akin to private citizens with commercial and charitable interests.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the Lord Chamberlain issued a letter at the king's direction on Sept. 7 stating the couple are private citizens and their charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity, directly substantiating the note's claims.
